reasons.record_complete: Record omits whether the backfill is batched, has an untested rollback script, one skipped test, no load test, and a backup pending verification, so it is not consistent enough to proceed as scheduled.
reasons.change_decision: The must_not rule (no checkout-table schema migration during a declared sales event) and the must rule (verified backup under 24h) both fail for the Tuesday window, and the prefer rule directs moving a risky change to a quiet window rather than cancelling, so rescheduling dominates.
reasons.change_risk: An 80-million-row non-null backfill on a checkout-critical table, batching unverified, during a live sale event with an unverified backup and untested rollback makes running it as scheduled high to very high risk.
